segments.he: הַנּוֹדֶרֶת הֲנָאָה וְכוּ׳. תְּנַן הָתָם, בָּרִאשׁוֹנָה הָיוּ אוֹמְרִים: שָׁלֹשׁ נָשִׁים יוֹצְאוֹת וְנוֹטְלוֹת כְּתוּבָּה.
segments.en: § It is taught in the mishna: If a woman «vows» during her husband’s lifetime to derive no «benefit» from her yavam, the court forces him to perform ḥalitza. «We learned» in a mishna «elsewhere» (Nedarim 90b): «At first they said: Three» categories of «women are divorced» from their husbands against their will, «and» even so they «receive payment» of their «marriage contract.»
